actions.name: Project Tasks (Power BI)
actions.caption: Project Tasks (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report that details tasks related to each project, with metrics for each task clearly outlined. It presents tasks in a table matrix in a hierarchical view, making it easy to navigate and analyze project task information.

actions.name: Project Profitability (Power BI)
actions.caption: Project Profitability (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report that displays key metrics such as Actuals and Budgeted KPIs, compares actual profit to the initial profit target, and includes a table view of project ledger entries by type.

actions.name: Project Realization (Power BI)
actions.caption: Project Realization (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report that features key metrics like Billable Invoice Price and Actual Total Price to support Realization percent per project. Enabling organizations to measure actual performance and achievements against planned or budgeted expectations.

actions.name: Project Performance to Budget (Power BI)
actions.caption: Project Performance to Budget (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report that highlights key metrics, including Budget Total Cost, Actual Total Cost, and the variance and percentage variance from the budget. It features a table that details these metrics by project, offering a clear view of cost performance and deviations from budgeted targets.

actions.name: Project Invoiced Sales by Type (Power BI)
actions.caption: Project Invoiced Sales by Type (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report that details invoiced sales for a project categorized by line type. It includes key KPIs such as % Invoiced, Billable Invoiced Price, and Billable Total Price, providing a clear overview of project invoicing performance and statistics.

actions.name: Project Invd. Sales by Cust. (Power BI)
actions.caption: Project Invd. Sales by Cust. (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report that details invoiced sales for a project, broken down by customer. It includes key KPIs such as % Invoiced, Billable Invoiced Price, and Billable Total Price, offering a clear view of project invoicing by customer.

actions.name: Work Center Statistics (Power BI)
actions.caption: Work Center Statistics (Power BI)

actions.name: Machine Center Statistics (Power BI)
actions.caption: Machine Center Statistics (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open the Power BI report that shows your machine center statistics and discover detailed metrics on total and effective capacity, expected and actual efficiency, scrap rates, and output.

actions.name: Machine Center Load (Power BI)
actions.caption: Machine Center Load (Power BI)

actions.name: Prod. Order - List (Power BI)
actions.caption: Production Order - List (Power BI)

actions.name: Production Order Overview (Power BI)
actions.caption: Production Order Overview (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open the Power BI report that presents key metrics and charts including a breakdown of total actual costs, the number of production orders by status, and the completion percentages for each source item.

actions.name: Prod. Order Routings Gantt (Power BI)
actions.caption: Production Order Routings Gantt (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open the Power BI report that visualizes the schedules of each work and machine center with a Gantt chart, detailing production order routing lines.

actions.name: Production Order WIP (Power BI)
actions.caption: Production Order WIP (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open the Power BI report that shows inventory valuation for selected production orders in your WIP inventory.

actions.name: Expected Capacity Need (Power BI)
actions.caption: Expected Capacity Need (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view the total hours scheduled to be performed for each Work Centre Group and/or Work Centre broken down by production order status and production order to analyze your requirement on factory resources.

actions.name: Manufacturing Report (Power BI)
actions.caption: Manufacturing Report (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report that offers a consolidated view of all manufacturing report pages, conveniently embedded into a single page for easy access.

actions.name: Finished Prod. Order Breakdown (Power BI)
actions.caption: Finished Production Order Breakdown (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view Expected Quantities and Cost vs. Actual Quantities and Costs over time, analyze the detail per item and drill down to the Production Order to track where variances are occurring.

actions.name: Average Productions Times (Power BI)
actions.caption: Average Productions Times (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view the average time spent for Setup, Run and Stop times per unit for each manufactured Item. Expand to see the times for each production order to determine why fluctuations occurred.

actions.name: Released Production Orders (Power BI)
actions.caption: Released Production Orders (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view how your released production orders are tracking by comparing Expected Quantity vs. Finished Quantity

actions.name: Current Utilization (Power BI)
actions.caption: Current Utilization (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view the current Weeks Utilization % by comparing Capacity Used to Available Capacity in Hours. View all or some Work Centers to measure throughput and efficiency.

actions.name: Allocated Hours (Power BI)
actions.caption: Allocated Hours (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view the number of hours remaining for production allocated to each Work Centre in a specified period. Allows you to determine if a Work Centre is under or overloaded and requires rescheduling.

actions.name: Consumption Variance (Power BI)
actions.caption: Consumption Variance (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view your consumption cost variance % viewed over a timeline you can define to see trends. Analyze by each production order and filter by Work Centre to see the detail behind the overall percentages.

actions.name: Capacity Variance (Power BI)
actions.caption: Capacity Variance (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view your capacity cost variance % viewed over a timeline you can define to see trends. Analyze by each production order and filter by Work Centre to see the detail behind the overall percentages.

actions.name: Production Scrap (Power BI)
actions.caption: Production Scrap (Power BI)
actions.tooltip: Open a Power BI Report to view your scrap quantities over a timeline you can define to see trends. Analyze further by Scrap Code, Location, Item Categories and by filtering for specific items.
